report.note: Missing reports are not a passing result; workflow gates remain authoritative.

interpretation.measured_api35: System Back gesture inset is78px at each horizontal edge. Old x=75px start lay inside it. New x=120px start and region reuse passed with foreground lifecycle/focus checks.
interpretation.measured_api29: Horizontal gesture insets are0. Original75px start remained unchanged and all31 cases passed.
interpretation.causal_scope: The controlled input margin plus lifecycle checks resolved the failure and supports system-gesture interference. There is no captured event trace of the earlier Back gesture, so do not claim isolated proof of that historical event.
interpretation.next_source: Independent source review found that the modal selector inherits NOT_FOCUSABLE and has no Back handling. A bounded focused-window cancellation change and one Android case are proposed; this record is not validation of that later source.
